notes:
Config: /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/mysqld.cnf
Port: 3306/tcp
Default DBs: information_schema, mysql, performance_schema, sys
Dangerous: user, password (in config), admin_address, debug, sql_warnings, secure_file_priv (empty = arbitrary file read/write)

recommended.note: Scan with mysql NSE scripts and connect to enumerate
